lines.text: Hungry Jesus finds only leaves on a fig tree and says, "May no one ever eat of your fruit again."
In the temple courts, Jesus overturns the tables of the tax collectors and the seats of those selling doves.
Jesus teaches that God's house is for prayer for all nations, but they made it a den of robbers.
Walking back in the morning, Thomas sees the fig tree withered from its roots and says it has withered.
Jesus tells them to have faith in God, believe they have received what they ask in prayer, and forgive others.
